description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “Sunnyside #7,” your dream beach getaway! Located in the Arcadia Community between Alys Beach and Seagrove Beach, steps from the community pool and Seabreeze public beach access (literally 1-min walk!). This bright retreat features 3 Suites and partial Gulf views from the 2nd-floor balcony. Hop on 4 included bikes to explore 30A, filled with charming shops and eateries, with the Big Chill entertainment center just a 6-minute ride away. Ready to unwind? Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to Beach Access: Just a 1-minute walk to the stunning white sandy beaches of 30A—feel the salty breeze and hear the soothing waves as you walk.Community Pool Nearby: Unwind and soak up the sun by the serene pool, conveniently located just steps from your door—perfect for a lazy afternoon or cooling off after a day in the sun.Peek-a-Boo Gulf Views: Savor peaceful ocean glimpses from your private second-floor balcony, where the gentle sea breeze sets the perfect mood for relaxation.4 Beach Bikes Included: Discover the charm of 30A on four provided bikes—pedal through scenic trails and enjoy the carefree coastal vibe.Prime Location: Immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of 30A, with easy access to The Big Chill, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach for gourmet dining, boutique shopping, and lively entertainment.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Generous towels, loved the upper deck’s ocean view, and appreciated the updates/reminders. Excellent option for relaxation!" – Anonymous⭐ "Absolutely loved the townhouse! Perfect for a girls’ trip. The beds were amazing and the location was unbeatable!" – Suzanne M.⭐ "Spacious with a perfect walk to the beach. Couldn’t ask for more for a family-friendly vacation." – Michael*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a perfect blend of comfort and style in this beautifully designed space. The open-concept living area on the 2nd floor is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining, offering a seamless, inviting flow. Decorated with cozy coastal touches like soft neutral tones, textured furnishings, and ocean-inspired accents, it’s perfect for unwinding after a long day. Large windows fill the room with natural light, creating a bright, airy space for family time or hosting friends.Expansive living area featuring luxurious seating and a smart TVCoastal-inspired décor creating a serene, relaxing atmospherePrivate 2nd floor balcony offering breathtaking views of the Gulf*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Elevate your cooking and dining experience! This fully equipped kitchen features modern appliances and high-performance cookware, ensuring meal preparation is both effortless and enjoyable. With ample counter space, a spacious island for prep or casual dining, and all the tools you need at your fingertips, it’s perfect for creating memorable meals to share with your group.Modern kitchen fully equipped with stainless-steel appliancesSpacious dining table that comfortably seats 6, plus extra seating for 3 at the breakfast barConvenient balcony access, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorPrimary Suite - King bed, private en-suite with tub/shower combo, double vanity, and direct patio accessKing Guest Suite- King bed with dedicated bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo2nd FloorBunk Room - 2 Twin-over-Twin bunks (sleeps 4), with shared access to a bathroom with a walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Take advantage of Arcadia Community's community pool, an ideal spot to unwind and cool off on warm, sunny days. Right across the street, the Seabreeze public beach access awaits, inviting you to enjoy its pristine white sands and the sparkling, clear waters of the Gulf.Just steps away from the community pool, complete with lounge chairs for relaxation1-Min Walk to Seabreeze public beach access for sun and sandIncludes 4 beach bikes, perfect for exploring the scenic 30A area*** NEARBY ATTRACTIONS ***Located in the vibrant Seacrest West, "Sunnyside #7" immerses you in the essence of the 30A lifestyle. Stroll through Alys Beach, enjoy a scenic bike ride to Rosemary Beach, or take a quick drive to the charming towns of Seaside, Watercolor and Seagrove. Surrounded by exceptional dining, unique shopping, and family-friendly entertainment, you'll find everything you need just moments away.The Big Chill – Located nearby (6-minute bike ride), this vibrant entertainment district is the perfect spot to unwind with live music, diverse restaurants, and unique shopping experiences.Alys Beach – Just a 4-minute drive away, this stunning seaside community offers a tranquil, luxurious vibe with its iconic white architecture and serene atmosphere.Rosemary Beach – A quick 5-minute drive takes you to this charming village known for its cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a lively yet relaxed vibe.Seaside – Only a 15-minute drive, this picturesque town exudes a classic, laid-back beach vibe with colorful cottages, outdoor markets, and scenic ocean views.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Parking available for 2 vehiclesWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210504STRO #: STR-210504
